title: Direct Salts Gummy Bear 10ml E-Liquid
description: Direct Salts Gummy Bear 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid offers a brilliantly playful and intensely sweet candy-inspired vape. The profile features a lively Mixed Fruit foundation, showcasing bright Citrus and rich Berry notes on the inhale. This vibrant fruit mix is expertly layered into a smooth, sugary Gummy base, perfectly replicating the distinct chewy texture and taste of the classic sweet shop favourite. The result is a delightfully playful and comforting sweet shop experience. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Direct Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Direct Salts collection offers vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and confectionery profiles. Providing a highly cost-effective and flexible option, this 10ml range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the sugary nostalgia of Gummy Bear, vapers can explore other compelling options such as the tropical Fruity Juice, the sharp Lemon Lime, or the crisp Spearmint.
